package extensionhost

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/collector"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/collector/jira"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/component"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/facts"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/scope"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/workflow"
)

type zzScenario struct {
	Name      string            `json:"name"`
	Env       map[string]string `json:"env"`
	Config    map[string]any    `json:"config"`
	Responses map[string]struct {
		Status  int               `json:"status"`
		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
		Body    json.RawMessage   `json:"body"`
	} `json:"responses"`
}

func zzKey(r *http.Request, body []byte) string {
	key := r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path
	if q := r.URL.Query(); len(q) > 0 {
		key += "?" + q.Encode()
	}
	if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
		var d struct {
			NextPageToken string `json:"nextPageToken"`
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(body, &d)
		key += "#" + d.NextPageToken
	}
	return key
}

func zzDrain(ch <-chan facts.Envelope) []facts.Envelope {
	var out []facts.Envelope
	for e := range ch {
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	return out
}

func zzNorm(t *testing.T, v any) any {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &out)
	return out
}

// TestZZHostRoundTrip drives the REAL extension host (ProcessRunner, NewSource,
// validator, payload-schema check, producer-grant recheck, envelope adapter)
// against the built extracted collector and a fake Jira over real HTTP, and
// compares the committed envelopes with the in-tree collector's. Throwaway.
func TestZZHostRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	bin := os.Getenv("JIRA_COLLECTOR_BIN")
	scenarioPath := os.Getenv("JIRA_SCENARIO")
	manifestPath := os.Getenv("JIRA_MANIFEST")
	if bin == "" || scenarioPath == "" || manifestPath == "" {
		t.Skip("JIRA_COLLECTOR_BIN / JIRA_SCENARIO / JIRA_MANIFEST not set")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(scenarioPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var s zzScenario
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		entry, ok := s.Responses[zzKey(r, body)]
		if !ok {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"errorMessages":["no entry"]}`))
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		for k, v := range entry.Headers {
			w.Header().Set(k, v)
		}
		w.WriteHeader(entry.Status)
		_, _ = w.Write(entry.Body)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	config := map[string]any{}
	for k, v := range s.Config {
		config[k] = v
	}
	config["base_url"] = server.URL
	for k, v := range s.Env {
		t.Setenv(k, v)
	}

	// Grants: nine core kinds, scope = the manifest's collector kind.
	var grants []component.ProducerGrant
	for _, kind := range facts.WorkItemFactKinds() {
		grants = append(grants, component.ProducerGrant{
			ProducerID: "dev.eshu.collector.jira", Version: "0.1.0", Kind: kind, SchemaVersions: []string{"1.0.0"},
			Scope: "jira", ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
		})
	}
	manifest, err := component.LoadManifestWithGrants(manifestPath, grants)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadManifestWithGrants: %v", err)
	}
	host, err := NewSource(Config{
		Manifest: manifest, CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa", ScopeKind: scope.KindJiraSite, ConfigHandle: "component-config:jira",
		Config: config, Grants: grants,
		Runner: ProcessRunner{Command: bin, Args: []string{"--sdk-stdio"}, StdoutLimitBytes: 64 << 20},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewSource: %v", err)
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	item := workflow.WorkItem{
		WorkItemID: "work-1", RunID: "run-1", SourceRunID: "run-1", CollectorKind: scope.CollectorJira, CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa",
		SourceSystem: "jira", ScopeID: "jira:site:fixture", TenantID: "tenant-1", WorkspaceID: "workspace-1", SubjectClass: "jira_site",
		PolicyRevisionHash: "policy-hash", AcceptanceUnitID: "acceptance-unit", GenerationID: "generation-1", FairnessKey: "jira:site:fixture",
		Status: workflow.WorkItemStatusClaimed, AttemptCount: 1, CurrentClaimID: "claim-1", CurrentFencingToken: 7, CurrentOwnerID: "worker-1",
		LeaseExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Hour), VisibleAt: now.Add(-time.Minute), LastClaimedAt: now.Add(-time.Second),
		CreatedAt: now.Add(-10 * time.Minute), UpdatedAt: now.Add(-time.Second),
	}
	hostGen, ok, err := host.NextClaimed(context.Background(), item)
	if len(s.Name) > 8 && s.Name[:8] == "failure_" && !(s.Name == "failure_metadata_forbidden_projects") {
		var hostFailure interface {
			FailureClass() string
			TerminalFailure() bool
		}
		if !errors.As(err, &hostFailure) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: host error %T %v is not a classified failure", s.Name, err, err)
		}
		in2, _ := jira.NewClaimedSource(jira.SourceConfig{
			CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa",
			Targets: []jira.TargetConfig{{
				ScopeID: "jira:site:fixture", SiteID: "x", BaseURL: server.URL, Email: s.Env["JIRA_EMAIL"], Token: s.Env["JIRA_TOKEN"], JQL: "project = ESHU", UpdatedLookback: time.Hour,
			}},
		})
		_, _, inErr := in2.NextClaimed(context.Background(), item)
		var inFailure interface {
			FailureClass() string
			TerminalFailure() bool
		}
		if !errors.As(inErr, &inFailure) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: in-tree error %T is not classified", s.Name, inErr)
		}
		if hostFailure.FailureClass() != inFailure.FailureClass() || hostFailure.TerminalFailure() != inFailure.TerminalFailure() {
			t.Fatalf("%s: host %s/terminal=%v, in-tree %s/terminal=%v", s.Name, hostFailure.FailureClass(), hostFailure.TerminalFailure(), inFailure.FailureClass(), inFailure.TerminalFailure())
		}
		t.Logf("%s: host and in-tree agree: class=%s terminal=%v", s.Name, hostFailure.FailureClass(), hostFailure.TerminalFailure())
		return
	}
	if err != nil || !ok {
		t.Fatalf("host NextClaimed: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
	}
	hostEnvs := zzDrain(hostGen.Facts)

	// In-tree collector against the same server.
	str := func(k string) string { v, _ := s.Config[k].(string); return v }
	num := func(k string) int { v, _ := s.Config[k].(float64); return int(v) }
	lookback, _ := time.ParseDuration(str("updated_lookback"))
	source, err := jira.NewClaimedSource(jira.SourceConfig{
		CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa",
		Targets: []jira.TargetConfig{{
			ScopeID: "jira:site:fixture", SiteID: str("site_id"), BaseURL: server.URL, Email: s.Env[str("email_env")], Token: s.Env[str("token_env")],
			JQL: str("jql"), IssueLimit: num("issue_limit"), UpdatedLookback: lookback, ChangelogLimit: num("changelog_limit"),
			RemoteLinkLimit: num("remote_link_limit"), MetadataLimit: num("metadata_limit"),
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	inGen, ok, err := source.NextClaimed(context.Background(), item)
	if err != nil || !ok {
		t.Fatalf("in-tree NextClaimed: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
	}
	inEnvs := zzDrain(inGen.Facts)

	// Compare scope + generation semantics.
	if hostGen.Scope.ScopeID != inGen.Scope.ScopeID || hostGen.Scope.ScopeKind != inGen.Scope.ScopeKind ||
		hostGen.Scope.SourceSystem != inGen.Scope.SourceSystem || hostGen.Scope.CollectorKind != inGen.Scope.CollectorKind {
		t.Fatalf("scope differs: host %+v in-tree %+v", hostGen.Scope, inGen.Scope)
	}
	if hostGen.Generation.GenerationID != inGen.Generation.GenerationID || hostGen.Generation.TrustedDeletion != inGen.Generation.TrustedDeletion {
		t.Fatalf("generation differs: host %+v in-tree %+v", hostGen.Generation, inGen.Generation)
	}
	t.Logf("generation: host status=%s trigger=%s hint=%.12s... in-tree hint=%.12s... (hints differ only through the wall-clock window)",
		hostGen.Generation.Status, hostGen.Generation.TriggerKind, hostGen.Generation.FreshnessHint, inGen.Generation.FreshnessHint)

	index := func(envs []facts.Envelope) map[string]facts.Envelope {
		m := map[string]facts.Envelope{}
		for _, e := range envs {
			m[e.FactKind+"\x00"+e.StableFactKey] = e // last wins, like the store
		}
		return m
	}
	hm, im := index(hostEnvs), index(inEnvs)
	var hk, ik []string
	for k := range hm {
		hk = append(hk, k)
	}
	for k := range im {
		ik = append(ik, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(hk)
	sort.Strings(ik)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(hk, ik) {
		t.Fatalf("fact key sets differ: host %d in-tree %d", len(hk), len(ik))
	}
	kinds := map[string]int{}
	for _, k := range hk {
		h, i := hm[k], im[k]
		kinds[h.FactKind]++
		if h.SchemaVersion != i.SchemaVersion || h.SourceConfidence != i.SourceConfidence || h.CollectorKind != i.CollectorKind ||
			h.ScopeID != i.ScopeID || h.GenerationID != i.GenerationID || h.FencingToken != i.FencingToken || h.IsTombstone != i.IsTombstone {
			t.Fatalf("%s: envelope metadata differs\n host %+v\n  in %+v", k, h, i)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(zzNorm(t, h.Payload), zzNorm(t, i.Payload)) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: payload differs", k)
		}
		if h.SourceRef != i.SourceRef {
			t.Fatalf("%s: source ref differs\n host %+v\n  in %+v", k, h.SourceRef, i.SourceRef)
		}
		if h.FactID == i.FactID {
			t.Fatalf("%s: fact ids are equal; the host namespace should make them differ", k)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("host round trip OK: %d unique facts compared, per kind %v; raw host envelopes %d, in-tree %d", len(hk), kinds, len(hostEnvs), len(inEnvs))
	_ = collector.CollectedGeneration{}
}
